decision.finding: Main retains Next 16.3.6 in the web manifest and lockfile and the older root dependency. The PR changes both manifests and both lockfiles, including proxy-addr.
decision.resolution: Carry one coherent dependency update across both install roots; frozen installs, audit, lint, types, build and tests. Revalidate advisory/version at implementation time; PR prose is not advisory verification.

decision.finding: Main fallback is v0.1.0; the source patch changes version, published date and five platform download URLs to v0.3.0. This is separate from the browser release-discovery path.
decision.resolution: Update fallback after checking release assets, platform names and integrity/signing evidence. Preserve dynamic newest-release lookup and offline/rate-limit fallback.

decision.finding: None of the 14 recovery paths is on main. Source head now reinstalls pgvector after both resets and contains two earlier fixture migrations for squash. The earlier single-fixture diagnosis is stale for this head.

decision.finding: Five source files are absent on main. Source head has executable inventory validation and three offline test bundles, despite its older description saying documentation only. build() initializes all 56 cells NOT_TESTED; an ordinary successful inventory job is not certification.
decision.resolution: Retain 7-by-8 coverage and three bundles, bind cells to executed evidence, and distinguish inventory success, offline contracts and live certification. Reuse current phase2/12-scenario suites; add no second intelligence router.

decision.finding: All added production lines in outcome_learning_handler, schema_param_extractor and sentiment_friction_service are present. Three proposed test files are absent, including role-boundary and incomplete-companion regression expectations.
decision.resolution: Preserve current services; adapt missing permission, alias extraction, timeout, sentiment and learning-delivery tests to actual routes and ReAct contracts. Do not restore the incomplete checkpoint wholesale or loosen admin-only endpoints to satisfy stale tests.

decision.finding: Main invoice notifications leave subscription status to lifecycle events and retain audit; cache invalidation is in finally. Both authority regression test functions are present and adapted to org_billing, unlike the older subscriptions assertion.

decision.finding: Source is one documentation file, not an implementation. It maps existing Connector/Capability/Agent/Approval/Run surfaces and explicitly makes granular grant UI and execution crosswalk conditional investigations.
decision.resolution: Preserve the matrix as dated source evidence. Add its grant-administration and MCP execution-ID crosswalk acceptance cases to the canonical plan; do not turn a documented question into an invented feature or new page.

decision.finding: Main already logs exception type, stage and code and exits 2. The proposed source only adds code to the older diagnostic.
decision.resolution: No port; keep richer main diagnostics and fail-closed exit.

decision.finding: Main router includes governed_recommendations with org/user/type/expiry single-use claim, workflow-only execution and verified=false until proof. Its service-only table migration replaces the old broader endpoint/table design. Main intentionally retains default-off lineage with approved environment allowance; source enables it globally. Roadmap toast wording differs.
decision.resolution: Preserve safer main endpoint and migration 20261022160000. Do not import old generic operator execution or duplicate migration. Keep environment-specific lineage policy; no automatic flag activation. Only adopt useful roadmap wording with a verified support contact.

decision.finding: Auth/session, Freshservice panel/proxy, lifecycle envelope, cost binding, approval scope and idempotency core changes are on main. Three historical migration names have timestamp-renamed equivalents. Main MSP access now requires explicit child membership and main write fingerprints/queue have later hardening.

decision.finding: Only a dated release-queue document. Main has an evolved version; its old pending PR list and sequential source-PR merge instruction conflict with the one-branch strategy.
decision.resolution: Retain single migration authority, SHA/checksum approval, staging, backups and append-only evidence. Replace old queue with this plan; no old merge train.

decision.finding: Most code and tests from all 63 changed paths are on main. Both historical SQL bodies are identical after ignoring comments/whitespace under newer timestamps. Main champion gate rejects uncomparable metrics, causal training uses measured deltas, and MCP approvals have claim-token fencing beyond this source.
decision.resolution: No wholesale port. Preserve current tenant filters, source liveness, dedupe, permission binding and stricter ML promotion. Do not restore permissive no-metric deployment or weaker MCP approval release. Port only genuinely absent test intent against current code.

decision.finding: Social repair, adaptive research and intent behavior are substantially present. Main lifecycle has newer identity/repeat-write handling; narration suppresses internal knowledge/search progress through normalized tokens. Acknowledgement wording differs but is not a missing capability.
decision.resolution: Preserve current runtime; carry useful behavioral cases for retries, status questions, internal narration and social repair. Do not replace newer lifecycle verification or restore stock acknowledgement lists as a latency fix.

decision.finding: Main is_echo_of protects explicit corrections and requires a contiguous match from one spoken segment. It has focused echo-correction tests; comment/wording differences are not missing behavior.
decision.resolution: No application port. Preserve real microphone barge-in and current per-turn cancellation; include source cases in regression selection.

decision.finding: Main listing path handles contacts/deals; source adds companies count, verified total handling and nearest-request continuation resolution. resolve_listing_read_message is absent. Main calls listing synchronously while source offloads I/O and guards replay-cache freshness.
decision.resolution: Adapt companies-count and continuation logic into the sealed read path, retaining pending approval ownership. Require fresh provider total; never count only the first page. Check cache bypass and async offload at current call boundary.

decision.finding: Main uses shared classify_conversation_tier with pending-task and escalation checks; voice/text prompt assembly uses conversation_dna_for_turn. Old JSON corpora are replaced by dialogue_library/runtime_fewshots.json and separate eval_conversations.json.

decision.finding: The three proposed orchestration files are absent. Main has conversation-parity, voice-SLO, revocation, standing batteries and 12-scenario workflows, but these do not reproduce the proposed combined backend + web + static acceptance entrypoint.
decision.resolution: Build one reusable combined gate using current test selectors and existing suites, on the consolidated head. Keep physical audibility/owner voice judgment separate from offline tests. Do not add duplicate suites or claim production acceptance from CI alone.

decision.finding: Dedicated builder and department-portfolio dispatch are absent. Main has generic Revenue Operations catalog content, which is not the same multi-play governed pack. Source depends on the missing department-portfolio substrate.
decision.resolution: Adapt flagship after pack schema/catalog/certification is coherent. Resolve real CRM capabilities, install children, outcome metrics and skill bindings; keep draft/internal until actual proof.

decision.finding: Main has registered managed Okta read handlers and most action extensions, including groups/apps/factors. Dedicated Security Operations pack and canonical eight-play registration are absent. Source action retrieval enrichment also differs.

decision.finding: Modern detail/installed pages and generic publish schema checks exist; explicit persisted-certification helper and seed certification guard do not. ROI changes overlap #276 exactly.

decision.finding: This source overlaps certification store/runner/evidence, Security Ops, department portfolio and UI from multiple PRs. Its permissions probe is fully present on main; the other major historical modules are absent.
decision.resolution: Use as dependency map, never as a whole merge. One canonical implementation of each #264/#265/#267/#271/#272 component, with safer #277/#289 variants and current frontend.

decision.finding: Read-only Okta/tool registration overlaps main and #277; pack and plays overlap later source variants.
decision.resolution: Absorb unique blueprint requirements into #277 adaptation; no second Security Ops builder or tool registry.

decision.finding: Main certify_outcome_pack permits production level from declared runtime status plus skill resolution, without runtime_evidence references. Source adds production environment/ref/action coverage and changes seed behavior.
decision.resolution: Require trusted ledger evidence for every advertised runtime action and measured outcome, bound to tenant/install/config/environment. Preserve existing outcome-contract tests and replace status-only certification.

decision.finding: Main lacks department_portfolio builder, seven referenced capability-package directories and department play registration. Modern frontend exists. Source original seeds production-verified tags, prices and savings; later variants change this to draft/internal.

decision.finding: Runner, production collector and API endpoints absent; authenticated tenant-isolation probe and tests already present. Historical collector filters org and asset-linked installs, but source-of-record success is any verified write rather than proof for all advertised actions.
decision.resolution: Reuse probe. Add restricted server-run certification, immutable evidence and action-complete coverage. Fixture mode may never promote production readiness. Fence environment/config/install/time and trusted writes; no caller-supplied proof.

decision.finding: Store, evidence table migration and explicit persisted evidence gate are absent. Main does have an indirect schema-level certification gate, so earlier claims of no publish gate were too broad. Historical FOR ALL authenticated membership RLS is unsafe for authoritative evidence.

decision.finding: Main MSP blueprint exists; source adds six explicit fresh-install/golden/failure/permissions/KPI/readback evidence requirements that current status-based certification lacks. Related #271 uses a different runtime-evidence contract.
